issues: 画面上方打着调试标题 CONFETTI CROSSFIRE，KPI 卡是 2px 灰边 + 两根灰骨架条 + Helvetica 回退
彩屑是同一平面的扁平色块，rotateX 没有透视读不出翻转，也没有前后景深
出膛 70–95px/f 的高速段每帧跳一大截，没有任何拖影，读作闪烁的碎点
下落段彩屑直线坠落，没有纸片的左右飘摆；揭晓帧卡片本身毫无反应
平灰底无层次，没有导出时长常量（工作台按默认 150f 猜）
changes: 导出 CONFETTI_CROSSFIRE_DURATION = 150；KPI 卡换出版级：发丝线 + 内高光 + 随抬升收紧的两层阴影，Customer satisfaction / 98.5% / ▲ 2.1 pts · 4,812 responses 真实文案
卡片 0.86→1 overshoot 落座 + 上浮 28px，揭晓帧受冲 1→1.018 阻尼回落，炮口一记 12f 柔光 puff
彩屑升级为真纸片：scaleY=|cos| 翻转、背面压暗 72%、过顶点后 10–32px 左右飘摆；保留原闭式弹道、初速与灰阶+1/3 琥珀配色
高速段按每帧速度沿运动方向拉伸最多 2.4×（<20px/f 复原），读作拖影而非跳点
三层景深：30% 远景 0.6× 压暗微虚、在卡片后方；18% 近景 1.5× 虚焦 1.8px、从卡片前掠过；柔光亮场 + 颗粒
issuesEn: A debug title CONFETTI CROSSFIRE sat on screen; the KPI card had a 2px grey border, two skeleton bars and Helvetica fallback
Confetti were flat chips on one plane; rotateX without perspective did not read as flipping, and there was no depth
During the 70–95px/f launch the pieces jumped huge distances per frame with no trail, reading as flickering dots
Pieces fell in straight lines with no paper flutter, and the card did not react at the reveal frame
Flat grey background and no exported duration constant (the workbench guessed 150f)
changesEn: Exported CONFETTI_CROSSFIRE_DURATION = 150; the KPI card is publication grade: hairline, inner highlight, two-layer shadow that tightens on landing, real copy Customer satisfaction / 98.5% / ▲ 2.1 pts · 4,812 responses
Card lands 0.86→1 with overshoot and a 28px rise, takes a damped 1→1.018 kick at the reveal, and each cannon gets a 12f soft muzzle puff
Confetti behave like paper: scaleY=|cos| flipping, back face darkened to 72%, 10–32px sway after the apex; original closed-form ballistics, speeds and grey + 1/3 amber palette kept
Fast pieces stretch up to 2.4× along their velocity (resetting below 20px/f), reading as a motion trail instead of jumping dots
Three depth layers: 30% far pieces at 0.6×, dimmed and soft behind the card; 18% near pieces at 1.5× with 1.8px defocus crossing in front; soft-lit light backdrop and grain
